headline: The site's evidence spine is complete, deterministic, publisher-safe, and now exposes every Desk argument for independent critique.

items.title: Progressive Changelog reaction hydration
items.insight: Reaction islands now wait until they approach the viewport, with a bounded idle fallback that never stalls all controls. Unavailable counts remain unavailable rather than becoming flattering zeroes.
items.evidence: 14/14 reviewed theme/device captures; focused hydration mutation gate

items.title: Distributional local performance evidence
items.insight: The lab warms once and retains raw multi-run distributions instead of presenting one lucky score. The Changelog verdict abstained as volatile, preserving the line between lab evidence and field Core Web Vitals.

items.title: Atomic mobile evidence under retry
items.insight: A process retry can no longer replace the shared evidence ledger with one worker's suffix. Navigation recovery stays bounded and the complete run remains a single-writer artifact.

items.title: Source-clocked generated provenance
items.insight: Forge RSS and feedback provenance now change only when their sources change. Exact-byte checks make scheduled rebuild churn observable instead of self-authorizing.

items.title: Complete checked-generator evidence graph
items.insight: Every checked generator was inspected for its real sources, outputs, and side effects. The resulting graph can now reason over the full evidence system instead of an admitted subset.

items.title: Publisher cascade closure
items.insight: Completing the graph exposed descendants that scheduled publishers could strand. Central build order and workflow staging now close every declared fan-out in the same atomic commit.

items.title: Meaningful Git-history window safety
items.insight: History summaries now stop after a useful semantic quota rather than truncating before noise is removed. Future raw numeric windows must fetch a sentinel and disclose their ceiling.

items.title: Byte-preserving CURRENT_STATE hot shard
items.insight: Startup no longer drags a 563 KB historical ledger through every turn. The exact preimage remains linked and recoverable, while collisions fail closed.

items.title: Outcome-based Desk feed probation
items.insight: Sources were judged by published work, not raw item volume. Two productive feeds remain and two non-performing feeds were removed after the declared eight-day observation window.

items.title: Stale umbrella tasks reconciled from live evidence
items.insight: Security, performance, elite-feature, visual-receipt, topic-yield, and unattended-publishing rows now reflect verified reality. The remaining cadence decision stays open because three editions are not proof of a four-slot promise.
items.evidence: Worker 56 tests · portal 18/18 · 12 scheduled Desk runs green

items.title: Per-story claim/evidence critique packets
items.insight: Every Desk story now exposes facts, arguments, predictions, and visual provenance as one deterministic packet. Unsupported claims are labelled unlinked, and a hash manifest lets agents verify all 30 packets without runtime model spend.

followUps: Migrate uptime sampling to a Worker scheduled handler plus daily KV drain as a dedicated trust-path release.
Close field-vitals freshness only after a genuinely fresh RUM cohort exists and bind it to a release SHA.
blockers: Founder-gated identity/privacy/newsletter/cadence/warm-origin decisions remain separate and unchanged.
IGNIS touched-repo rescore attempted the sibling studio-ops target and exited without a score; no cross-repo file was edited directly.

honestyLedger.title: No phantom field green
honestyLedger.why: The volatile Changelog lab distribution abstained; no local run was relabelled as field Core Web Vitals.

honestyLedger.title: Unsupported means unlinked
honestyLedger.why: Predictions without factRefs remain explicit gaps in every critique packet.

honestyLedger.title: Trust migration kept whole
honestyLedger.why: The uptime Actions-to-Worker rewrite was deferred to a dedicated staged release rather than compressed into closeout.
